links.outcome: Readability (FRE, FKGL) of ASSH and AI-generated patient education materials versus sixth-grade target
links.effect: ASSH PEMs FRE 57.5, FKGL 9.4 (10th-12th grade); initial Gemini FRE 49.7, FKGL 9.6; ChatGPT FRE 47.4, FKGL 10.4 (college level), all above sixth grade.
links.quote: The ASSH website and AI-generated PEMs initially exceeded the sixth-grade readability level.

links.outcome: Readability of AI materials when prompted to write at sixth-grade level versus original ASSH materials
links.effect: AI-generated PEMs at sixth-grade readability had lower word counts, higher FRE, and lower FKGL than original ASSH PEMs (all P < .001).
links.quote: Artificial intelligence-rewritten ASSH content had improved readability, and AI-generated PEMs at a sixth-grade readability had lower word counts, higher FRE, and lower FKGL than original ASSH PEMs (all P < .001).

screen.reason: Evaluates prompting LLMs with explicit reading-level constraints (requesting a sixth-grade reading level) to assess readability of patient education materials compared to baseline unconstrained generation.
